findings.what: LookGallery imports the private helper `_downscale_strips` from lattice_core.ui.worker.
findings.why: Cross-module use of a private name inside the same package is fragile; the public `preview_proxy()` already wraps it.
findings.fix: Use `preview_proxy(source, THUMB_SOURCE_SIDE)` (float path) or promote `_downscale_strips` to a public name in worker.py.

findings.what: `is_visible_without_image()` returns `not NO_IMAGE_HIDDEN`, i.e. a constant False; the flag it reads is never mutated.
findings.why: Dead accessor that can never report anything but False; misleading API surface.
findings.fix: Either remove the method or make NO_IMAGE_HIDDEN a constructor parameter.

findings.what: bridge.py, export_dialog.py and svg.py are not `ruff format` clean (line-wrap only).
findings.why: `ruff check` (the gate lint) passes; repo-wide `ruff format --check` already flags 38 pre-existing files, so this is consistency noise, not a gate failure.
